note: Confirmed from a macOS user's logs. The pinned comfyui_controlnet_aux requirements.txt ends with an unmarked onnxruntime-gpu, which has no macOS wheel at any version, so pip resolves nothing and the whole node install fails. Retry is deterministic failure. Local engine only - the Pod bakes this node into a CUDA Linux image. Fix cannot live in the command string because runCustomCommand spawns without a shell.
